subject.title: Control UI fails to load on Firefox desktop behind reverse proxy — CSP blocks Vite runtime eval(), 'Control UI did not start', WebSocket 1006

question: Should maintainers keep this issue separate for Firefox/nginx WebSocket 1006 proof while the overlapping CSP/Zod work remains on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362?
rationale: The CSP evidence overlaps an existing security-sensitive thread, but this report adds a distinct TLS reverse-proxy failure mode that has not been live-reproduced on current main.

options.title: Keep Separate Pending Proxy Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open for the Firefox/nginx 1006 path while using the older CSP issue for the shared Zod/no-eval repair.

options.title: Consolidate Under CSP Thread
options.body: Treat the 1006 symptom as startup fallout from CSP-blocked JavaScript and move all remaining work to the existing CSP/Zod issue.

options.title: Sponsor CSP Fix First
options.body: Fix the strict-CSP Zod path first, then ask for fresh Firefox reverse-proxy proof only if the socket failure remains.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Pending Proxy Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the Firefox/nginx 1006 path while using the older CSP issue for the shared Zod/no-eval repair.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across Control UI CSP, bootstrap, and Gateway WebSocket security behavior.
